docs.description: Issues a revocable Host-owned session for signature-validated JPEG, PNG, or WebP content after validating the Plugin principal, owning node, direct edge, resource identity, and image limits. Every protocol read revalidates the issued principal and direct edge against current Host state.
docs.remarks: Electron protocol GET/HEAD requests have no trusted sender or frame principal. Possession of the convax-connected-media URL therefore carries bearer authority until the Host revokes the session or its principal/edge revalidation fails; the URL must be kept secret and closed promptly. The response contains no image bytes, native path, or unrestricted URL. The Host rejects images above 16 MiB, dimensions above 8192 pixels, or more than 33,554,432 pixels.
docs.request: `{ inputKey }`, using an opaque image key returned by canvas.inputs.list.
docs.response: A connection-issued, revocable session with an opaque 128-bit bearer URL, bounded image probe, and lowercase SHA-256 content revision.
docs.summary: Open one directly connected image through the owning Plugin node.
